title: Suunto Watch Will Not Charge
shortDescription: Charge clip does not start charging.
fullDescription: Suunto's POGO pin clip is sensitive to corrosion. Cleaning the pins on watch and clip resolves most charge failures.

fixSteps.title: Clean pins
fixSteps.instruction: Use isopropyl swab on watch and clip pins.

whenToCallPro: Suunto warranty if cleaning + new cable doesn't work.

faq.q: Can I use a magnetic charger?

title: Suunto GPS Takes Forever to Lock
shortDescription: Several minutes to acquire GPS at run start.
fullDescription: Suunto pulls A-GPS data via the Suunto app. If app sync is rare, A-GPS is stale and TTFF balloons.

fixSteps.title: Open app
fixSteps.instruction: Open Suunto app within Bluetooth range to push A-GPS.

fixSteps.title: Wait outside
fixSteps.instruction: Stand outdoors for 1-2 min before starting.

faq.a: Vertical, Race, and 9 Peak Pro have dual-band L1+L5.

title: Suunto App Won't Sync Workouts
shortDescription: Sync stalls or completes with no new data.
fullDescription: Sync depends on Bluetooth permissions and a current app version. Some older watches sync via SuuntoLink desktop only.

fixSteps.title: Permissions
fixSteps.instruction: Grant Bluetooth + Location to Suunto app.

fixSteps.title: SuuntoLink
fixSteps.instruction: Install SuuntoLink on Mac/PC for older models.

title: Suunto Touchscreen Won't Respond
fullDescription: Soft reset by holding power button typically clears stuck UI. Touch is also disabled when wet or in workout to prevent false presses.
whenToCallPro: If reset doesn't help — digitizer fault.

title: Suunto Wrist Heart Rate Wildly Off
shortDescription: HR locks to step rate during runs.
fullDescription: Optical HR cadence-locking is common when strap is loose. Tighter fit and bicep position improve accuracy.

fixSteps.title: Tighten and reposition
fixSteps.instruction: Wear snug 1-2 fingers above wrist bone.

faq.a: 1-2 fingers above wrist bone, snug fit.

title: Suunto Barometric Altimeter Showing Wrong Altitude
shortDescription: Altitude reading drifts with weather changes.
fullDescription: Suunto baro altimeters track pressure; weather changes cause drift. Use Auto profile or calibrate at known elevation.

fixSteps.title: Calibrate
fixSteps.instruction: Set known altitude in Settings > Outdoor.

faq.a: Some models use FusedAlti combining baro+GPS.

title: Suunto Watch Stuck on Boot Logo
fullDescription: Boot loops are commonly fixed by hard reset; severe cases need SuuntoLink to reflash firmware.

fixSteps.title: Hard reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold all buttons together for 30 sec.

fixSteps.title: SuuntoLink reflash
fixSteps.instruction: Connect to PC and use SuuntoLink to reinstall firmware.

title: Suunto Watch Won't Pair With Phone
fullDescription: Permissions or stale pairing cache are the usual culprits.

fixSteps.title: Clear pairing
fixSteps.instruction: Forget device in OS Bluetooth settings, retry from app.

title: Suunto Battery Drops Faster Than Expected
shortDescription: Battery dies in 1-2 days vs rated 7-14.
fullDescription: Always-on display, dual-band GPS, and constant HR sampling drain quickly. Adjust battery profile for longer life.

fixSteps.title: Endurance profile
fixSteps.instruction: Use Endurance battery profile for long activities.

title: Suunto Watch Strap Detached
shortDescription: Quick-release pin or strap material failed.
fullDescription: Suunto uses 22mm/26mm quick release straps. Replacement is 5-minute swap.
